title: Persona-Model Collapse in Emergent Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2605.12850v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow data with harmful content produces broadly misaligned behavior on unrelated prompts, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment. We propose that emergent misalignment involves persona-model collapse: a deterioration of the internal representations that encode and distinguish personas, undermining the nuance and consistency of their expression. We first test this hypothesis behaviorally, by comparing how models fine-tuned on harmful data and benign controls answer questionnaires while role-playing diverse personas. Across four model families, harmful fine-tuning produces more polarized, all-or-nothing answers, suggesting more binary, less nuanced persona expression. Histograms show increased concentration at the scale endpoints, and Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence quantifies the distributional shift. We also find reduced within-persona consistency: repeated answers to the same quest

translated_title: 涌现性失调中的人格模型坍缩
translated_abstract: 在包含有害内容的狭窄数据上对大型语言模型进行微调，会使模型在与该数据无关的提示上也表现出广泛的对齐失调，这种现象被称为“涌现性失调”。我们提出，涌现性失调涉及“人格模型坍缩”：即编码和区分人格的内部表征发生退化，从而破坏了人格表达的细腻性与一致性。我们首先从行为层面检验这一假设：比较在有害数据上微调的模型与良性对照模型在扮演多样化人格时对问卷的回答。在四个模型家族中，有害微调产生了更极化、“非全即无”的回答，表明人格表达变得更加二元化、细腻程度更低。直方图显示回答在量表两端更为集中，并通过库尔贝克—莱布勒（KL）散度对这种分布偏移进行了量化。我们还发现人格内部一致性有所降低：对同一问题的重复回答……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“人格模型坍缩”假说，指出有害数据微调引发的涌现性失调源于模型内部人格表征的退化，并在四个模型家族上通过问卷实验证实有害微调使人格表达更极化、更二元化且内部一致性降低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that emergent misalignment arises from "persona-model collapse"—a degradation of internal persona representations—and shows across four model families that harmful fine-tuning makes persona expression more polarized, binary, and internally inconsistent.
